answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 13 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The karst multiplier is published, charged in sonnet, and ripple lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 3143 identities would post 2953 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
